$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for invoice-classify (ebilling-r1 task 042, FR-46). The Action is a Linear AI Consumer reached only through IInvoiceAi.ClassifyAsync (Binding carries no tool description, so it is never loop-projected); the schema documents the operand the facade sends as the '## Input' section ({ documentText }) and is validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests like every other mirror. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (use the object-level required array). actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene). The tenant id travels in the LinearRunContext, never in the operand. Deployed to the row by scripts/ebilling/Ensure-ActionRow.ps1.

documentText.description: The extracted text of the Finance attachment to classify (AttachmentClassificationJobHandler, from TextExtractorService). Content only; the model is told to treat it as data, never as instructions.
